q: 我的桌子比你的___大。
zh: 我的桌子比你的大。
py: wǒ de zhuō zi bǐ nǐ de dà
en: My desk is bigger than yours.
why: After 比 B the adjective stands bare, so 大 takes nothing in front of it. 很 and 太 are degree words that clash with the comparison.

q: 今天经理比昨天___忙，连午饭都没吃。
zh: 今天经理比昨天更忙，连午饭都没吃。
py: jīn tiān jīng lǐ bǐ zuó tiān gèng máng lián wǔ fàn dōu méi chī
en: The manager is even busier today than yesterday; he didn't even have lunch.
why: Only 更 (or 还) may stand before the adjective in a 比 sentence, and here it says 'even busier'. 很, 非常 and 比较 cannot appear in 比 sentences.

q: 这家医院比那家___远。
zh: 这家医院比那家远。
py: zhè jiā yī yuàn bǐ nà jiā yuǎn
en: This hospital is farther away than that one.
why: A plain 比 comparison keeps the adjective bare. 太 and 非常 cannot go before 远 once 比 is in the sentence.

q: 这个月的工作比上个月___多，大家每天都要加班。
zh: 这个月的工作比上个月多，大家每天都要加班。
py: zhè ge yuè de gōng zuò bǐ shàng ge yuè duō dà jiā měi tiān dōu yào jiā bān
en: This month's workload is bigger than last month's, so everyone has to work overtime every day.
why: With 比, 多 stays bare. 很 and 非常 do not combine with 比; 'a lot more' would go after the adjective instead.

q: 这个药比那个药贵___。
zh: 这个药比那个药贵一点儿。
py: zhè ge yào bǐ nà ge yào guì yī diǎn r
en: This medicine is a bit more expensive than that one.
why: A small difference goes after the adjective: 贵一点儿. 有点儿 goes before an adjective, and 很 can never follow one.

q: 坐地铁去公司比开车快___，不用堵车。
zh: 坐地铁去公司比开车快得多，不用堵车。
py: zuò dì tiě qù gōng sī bǐ kāi chē kuài de duō bù yòng dǔ chē
en: Taking the subway to the office is much faster than driving; there's no traffic jam.
why: 'Much' after the adjective is 得多. 很, 有点儿 and 非常 all belong before an adjective and cannot follow 快.

q: 他今天的咳嗽比昨天好___。
zh: 他今天的咳嗽比昨天好多了。
py: tā jīn tiān de ké sou bǐ zuó tiān hǎo duō le
en: His cough is much better today than yesterday.
why: 好多了 is the set way to say 'much better' in a 比 sentence. 很, 非常 and 太 cannot be attached to 好 here.

q: 我的血压比去年低___，医生说不用吃药了。
zh: 我的血压比去年低一些，医生说不用吃药了。
py: wǒ de xuè yā bǐ qù nián dī yī xiē yī shēng shuō bù yòng chī yào le
en: My blood pressure is a little lower than last year; the doctor says I no longer need medicine.
why: A small difference follows the adjective: 低一些. 有点儿 and 非常 stand before an adjective and do not work in a 比 sentence.

q: 新来的同事比我___三岁，可是工作经验比我多。
zh: 新来的同事比我小三岁，可是工作经验比我多。
py: xīn lái de tóng shì bǐ wǒ xiǎo sān suì kě shì gōng zuò jīng yàn bǐ wǒ duō
en: The new colleague is three years younger than me, but he has more work experience.
why: The number goes right after a bare adjective: 小三岁. 很小 puts a degree word in front, and 小得 would need a complement of its own.

q: 这家公司的工资比我们公司高___，所以不少人想去那儿工作。
zh: 这家公司的工资比我们公司高得多，所以不少人想去那儿工作。
py: zhè jiā gōng sī de gōng zī bǐ wǒ men gōng sī gāo de duō suǒ yǐ bù shǎo rén xiǎng qù nà r gōng zuò
en: This company's pay is much higher than ours, so quite a few people want to work there.
why: The size of a big difference follows the adjective: 高得多. 很 and 有点儿 cannot come after 高.

q: 病人今天没有昨天___难受。
zh: 病人今天没有昨天那么难受。
py: bìng rén jīn tiān méi yǒu zuó tiān nà me nán shòu
en: The patient isn't as uncomfortable today as yesterday.
why: 'Not as ... as' is 没有 B (那么) + adjective. 很 and 比 cannot be added after 没有 B.

q: 我的工作没有你的___累。
zh: 我的工作没有你的累。
py: wǒ de gōng zuò méi yǒu nǐ de lèi
en: My job isn't as tiring as yours.
why: After 没有 B the adjective is bare (or has 这么/那么). 很 or 比 cannot be inserted before 累.

q: 这个办公室___那个办公室大，只有那个的一半，我们得搬走。
zh: 这个办公室没有那个办公室大，只有那个的一半，我们得搬走。
py: zhè ge bàn gōng shì méi yǒu nà ge bàn gōng shì dà zhǐ yǒu nà ge de yī bàn wǒ men de bān zǒu
en: This office is not as big as that one, only half the size, so we have to move.
why: 'Clearly smaller' is 没有 B + adjective. 不比 would only say 'not bigger', which is not the point when it is half the size. 比不 is not a pattern.

q: 坐公共汽车去医院没有坐地铁___，所以我每次都坐地铁。
zh: 坐公共汽车去医院没有坐地铁快，所以我每次都坐地铁。
py: zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù yī yuàn méi yǒu zuò dì tiě kuài suǒ yǐ wǒ měi cì dōu zuò dì tiě
en: Taking the bus to the hospital isn't as fast as taking the subway, so I always take the subway.
why: After 没有 B the adjective stays bare. An amount like 得多 or a degree word like 很 cannot follow it.

q: 你说他比我高？他___我高，我们一样高。
zh: 你说他比我高？他不比我高，我们一样高。
py: nǐ shuō tā bǐ wǒ gāo tā bù bǐ wǒ gāo wǒ men yī yàng gāo
en: You say he's taller than me? He's no taller than me; we're the same height.
why: 不比 means 'not more than', so equal height is possible. 没有 and 不如 say he is clearly shorter, which contradicts 一样高.

q: 我的英语___小王，他在美国住过五年。
zh: 我的英语不如小王，他在美国住过五年。
py: wǒ de yīng yǔ bù rú xiǎo wáng tā zài měi guó zhù guò wǔ nián
en: My English is not as good as Xiao Wang's; he lived in America for five years.
why: 不如 B can stand alone to mean 'not as good as B'. 不比 needs an adjective and means something else, and 比不 is not a pattern.

q: 坐班车___自己开车方便，所以他还是每天开车上班。
zh: 坐班车不如自己开车方便，所以他还是每天开车上班。
py: zuò bān chē bù rú zì jǐ kāi chē fāng biàn suǒ yǐ tā hái shì měi tiān kāi chē shàng bān
en: Taking the shuttle bus is not as convenient as driving yourself, so he still drives to work every day.
why: 不如 B + a good quality (方便) means 'not as ... as B'. 不是 and 不太 cannot take a 'than' phrase.

q: 我的手机___你的一样。
zh: 我的手机跟你的一样。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī gēn nǐ de yī yàng
en: My phone is the same as yours.
why: Sameness is 跟 (or 和) ... 一样. 比 and 没有 mark a difference, which contradicts 一样.

q: 小王和我___高。
zh: 小王和我一样高。
py: xiǎo wáng hé wǒ yī yàng gāo
en: Xiao Wang and I are equally tall.
why: 和 ... 一样 + adjective says two things are equal. 一点儿 and 一些 only describe a small amount.

q: 我们公司的上班时间跟他们公司___，他们九点，我们八点半。
zh: 我们公司的上班时间跟他们公司不一样，他们九点，我们八点半。
py: wǒ men gōng sī de shàng bān shí jiān gēn tā men gōng sī bù yí yàng tā men jiǔ diǎn wǒ men bā diǎn bàn
en: Our working hours are different from theirs: they start at nine, we start at half past eight.
why: 'Different' is 跟 B 不一样. 没有 and 不比 are for comparing degree with an adjective and do not fit here.

q: 今天医院的病人跟昨天一样___，一直排到门口。
zh: 今天医院的病人跟昨天一样多，一直排到门口。
py: jīn tiān yī yuàn de bìng rén gēn zuó tiān yī yàng duō yì zhí pái dào mén kǒu
en: There are just as many patients at the hospital today as yesterday; the line reaches the door.
why: After 一样 the adjective is bare: 一样多. 很 and 更 cannot be added, and 更 would also change the meaning.

q: 我们办公室七个人里，小李___忙。
zh: 我们办公室七个人里，小李最忙。
py: wǒ men bàn gōng shì qī ge rén lǐ xiǎo lǐ zuì máng
en: Of the seven people in our office, Xiao Li is the busiest.
why: 最 picks the top of a group of three or more. 更 needs one thing to be compared with, and 比较 only means 'fairly'.

q: 这个药很苦，那个药___苦。
zh: 这个药很苦，那个药更苦。
py: zhè ge yào hěn kǔ nà ge yào gèng kǔ
en: This medicine is bitter and that one is even more bitter.
why: 更 means 'even more' than something just mentioned. 最 needs a group of three or more, and 比较 would only say 'fairly bitter'.

q: 这家公司的工资___高，不过不是最高的，工作也很累。
zh: 这家公司的工资比较高，不过不是最高的，工作也很累。
py: zhè jiā gōng sī de gōng zī bǐ jiào gāo bù guò bú shì zuì gāo de gōng zuò yě hěn lèi
en: The pay at this company is fairly high, though not the highest, and the work is tiring.
why: 比较 means 'fairly' with no B named. 不是最高的 rules out 最 here, and 更 would need something to compare with.

q: 在我们公司，经理___早到，每个人都比他晚。
zh: 在我们公司，经理最早到，每个人都比他晚。
py: zài wǒ men gōng sī jīng lǐ zuì zǎo dào měi ge rén dōu bǐ tā wǎn
en: In our company the manager arrives earliest; everyone is later than him.
why: 'Everyone is later' makes him the top of the group, so 最. 更 needs a single comparison and 比较 would only be 'fairly early'.

q: 这件事是我们办公室里___重要的。
zh: 这件事是我们办公室里最重要的。
py: zhè jiàn shì shì wǒ men bàn gōng shì lǐ zuì zhòng yào de
en: This is the most important matter in our office.
why: The group goes first and 最 stands right before 重要: 最重要的. 很 and 比较 would not give 'the most'.

q: 小王比我打字打___快。
zh: 小王比我打字打得快。
py: xiǎo wáng bǐ wǒ dǎ zì dǎ de kuài
en: Xiao Wang types faster than me.
why: An action compared by manner needs verb + 得 + adjective. 的 and 地 are different particles and cannot link a verb to its complement.

q: 他今天起___比我早，七点就到公司了。
zh: 他今天起得比我早，七点就到公司了。
py: tā jīn tiān qǐ de bǐ wǒ zǎo qī diǎn jiù dào gōng sī le
en: He got up earlier than me today; he was at the company by seven.
why: 起得比我早 keeps 得 between the verb and the comparison. 起了 would just say he got up.

q: 他说汉语说得___我好。
zh: 他说汉语说得比我好。
py: tā shuō hàn yǔ shuō de bǐ wǒ hǎo
en: He speaks Chinese better than I do.
why: 比 + the person compared sits right after 得. 跟 would mean 'the same as', and 更 has no 'than' phrase.

q: 弟弟睡___比我多，每天睡十个小时。
zh: 弟弟睡得比我多，每天睡十个小时。
py: dì di shuì de bǐ wǒ duō měi tiān shuì shí ge xiǎo shí
en: My younger brother sleeps more than I do, ten hours a day.
why: Verb + 得 + 比我 + adjective compares how much he sleeps. 的 and 地 cannot take the place of 得 here.

q: 奶奶的身体___好了，每天都能散步。
zh: 奶奶的身体越来越好了，每天都能散步。
py: nǎi nǎi de shēn tǐ yuè lái yuè hǎo le měi tiān dōu néng sàn bù
en: Grandma's health is getting better and better; she can take a walk every day.
why: 'More and more' is the fixed 越来越 before the adjective. 越 alone needs a second 越, and 非常 does not mean a change over time.

q: 他每天跑步，跑得___快了。
zh: 他每天跑步，跑得越来越快了。
py: tā měi tiān pǎo bù pǎo de yuè lái yuè kuài le
en: He runs every day and runs faster and faster.
why: With an action verb 越来越 goes after 得, right before the adjective. 越来 is incomplete and 不太 says the opposite.

q: 天气越来越冷，医院里感冒的病人也___多了。
zh: 天气越来越冷，医院里感冒的病人也越来越多了。
py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè lěng yī yuàn lǐ gǎn mào de bìng rén yě yuè lái yuè duō le
en: The weather is getting colder, and there are more and more patients with colds at the hospital.
why: 越来越 is a fixed three-syllable pattern. 越来 and 越是 are not ways to say 'more and more'.

q: 听说这个城市的空气___差，很多人都生病了。
zh: 听说这个城市的空气越来越差，很多人都生病了。
py: tīng shuō zhè ge chéng shì de kōng qì yuè lái yuè chà hěn duō rén dōu shēng bìng le
en: I hear the air in this city is getting worse and worse and many people have fallen ill.
why: 越来越 already supplies the degree, so 很 cannot follow it. 更 needs something to compare with and does not show gradual change.

q: 他的汉语说得___好，同事们都夸他。
zh: 他的汉语说得越来越好，同事们都夸他。
py: tā de hàn yǔ shuō de yuè lái yuè hǎo tóng shì men dōu kuā tā
en: His Chinese is getting better and better, and his colleagues all praise him.
why: After 得 the pattern is 越来越 + adjective. 越 and 越来 alone are incomplete.

zh: 今天的工作比昨天的多。
py: jīn tiān de gōng zuò bǐ zuó tiān de duō
en: Today's work is more than yesterday's.
why: 比 B goes between A and the bare adjective. 多 cannot come before 比 and no 很 is needed.

zh: 我的感冒比你的更重。
py: wǒ de gǎn mào bǐ nǐ de gèng zhòng
en: My cold is even worse than yours.
why: 更 sits right before the adjective and after 比 B. Putting 更 before 比 breaks the pattern.

zh: 他们部门的电脑比我们部门的还旧。
py: tā men bù mén de diàn nǎo bǐ wǒ men bù mén de hái jiù
en: The computers in their department are even older than the ones in ours.
why: 还 goes after 比 B and right before the adjective, meaning 'even older'. 旧 cannot come before 比.

zh: 医院比公司远。
py: yī yuàn bǐ gōng sī yuǎn
en: The hospital is farther away than the company.
why: A 比 B + adjective: the thing compared with comes between 比 and 远. English 'farther than' order does not carry over.

zh: 我比小王大一岁。
py: wǒ bǐ xiǎo wáng dà yī suì
en: I'm one year older than Xiao Wang.
why: The amount of the difference goes after the adjective: 大一岁. 一岁大 before the adjective is wrong.

zh: 这瓶药比那瓶贵十块。
py: zhè píng yào bǐ nà píng guì shí kuài
en: This bottle of medicine is ten yuan more expensive than that one.
why: Number + measure follows the adjective in a 比 sentence: 贵十块. Placing 十块 before 贵 is the English order.

zh: 做手术比吃药贵得多。
py: zuò shǒu shù bǐ chī yào guì de duō
en: Having an operation is much more expensive than taking medicine.
why: 'Much' is 得多 after the adjective. 很 cannot stand before 贵 in a 比 sentence.

zh: 这次体检的血压比上次低一些。
py: zhè cì tǐ jiǎn de xuè yā bǐ shàng cì dī yī xiē
en: The blood pressure at this check-up is a little lower than last time.
why: A small difference, 一些, comes after the adjective 低. 有点儿 before 低 would break the 比 pattern.

zh: 我没有经理忙。
py: wǒ méi yǒu jīng lǐ máng
en: I'm not as busy as the manager.
why: 'Not as ... as' is A 没有 B + adjective. The adjective is not negated and 比 is not used.

zh: 坐地铁没有打车那么方便。
py: zuò dì tiě méi yǒu dǎ chē nà me fāng biàn
en: Taking the subway is not as convenient as taking a taxi.
why: 没有 B 那么 + adjective is the 'not as ... as' frame; 那么 goes right before the adjective.

zh: 他的病不比我的轻。
py: tā de bìng bù bǐ wǒ de qīng
en: His illness is no milder than mine.
why: 不 goes before 比, not before the adjective: 不比 B + adjective. 比我的不轻 is wrong.

zh: 我的汉语不如你。
py: wǒ de hàn yǔ bù rú nǐ
en: My Chinese is not as good as yours.
why: A 不如 B says A is not as good as B, with no 比 and no adjective needed.

zh: 我跟他一样高。
py: wǒ gēn tā yī yàng gāo
en: I'm as tall as he is.
why: 跟 B 一样 + adjective is the frame for 'as ... as'. 比 is never used with 一样.

zh: 我的工资和你的不一样。
py: wǒ de gōng zī hé nǐ de bù yí yàng
en: My salary is not the same as yours.
why: 和 B 不一样 says the two things differ. 一样 and the negative 不 stay together after B.

zh: 这家医院的服务跟那家一样好。
py: zhè jiā yī yuàn de fú wù gēn nà jiā yī yàng hǎo
en: This hospital's service is as good as that one's.
why: 跟 那家 一样 好: the adjective follows 一样 directly, with no 很 in between.

zh: 我最喜欢星期五。
py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan xīng qī wǔ
en: I like Friday best.
why: 最 goes before the verb 喜欢 and after the subject, not at the end of the sentence.

zh: 他是我们部门最年轻的。
py: tā shì wǒ men bù mén zuì nián qīng de
en: He is the youngest in our department.
why: The group 我们部门 goes before 最, and 最 stands right before 年轻的. English 'youngest in the department' order fails.

zh: 我们部门这个月比较忙。
py: wǒ men bù mén zhè ge yuè bǐ jiào máng
en: Our department is fairly busy this month.
why: 比较 is an adverb directly before 忙, with no B named. It cannot be placed at the start or after the adjective.

zh: 他比我写得快。
py: tā bǐ wǒ xiě de kuài
en: He writes faster than me.
why: Both 他比我写得快 and 他写得比我快 are fine, but 得 must stay on the verb and the adjective comes last.

zh: 妹妹比我睡得晚多了。
py: mèi mei bǐ wǒ shuì de wǎn duō le
en: My younger sister goes to sleep much later than I do.
why: 比我 goes before 睡得 or right after it. The amount 多了 closes the sentence after the adjective.

zh: 妹妹唱歌唱得比我好。
py: mèi mei chàng gē chàng de bǐ wǒ hǎo
en: My younger sister sings better than I do.
why: With an object the verb is repeated: 唱歌唱得 ... 比我 can also sit before the second 唱得 or before 唱歌. 歌 cannot stand between 唱 and 得.

zh: 今天我比昨天起得早。
py: jīn tiān wǒ bǐ zuó tiān qǐ de zǎo
en: I got up earlier today than yesterday.
why: Verb + 得 + adjective compares the manner of the action. 比昨天 sits before 起得, and the adjective 早 goes last.

zh: 天气越来越冷了。
py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè lěng le
en: The weather is getting colder and colder.
why: 越来越 goes right before the adjective and 了 closes the sentence to mark the change.

zh: 医院里的人越来越多了。
py: yī yuàn lǐ de rén yuè lái yuè duō le
en: There are more and more people in the hospital.
why: The subject comes first, then 越来越 immediately before 多, then 了.

zh: 小李跑步跑得越来越慢了。
py: xiǎo lǐ pǎo bù pǎo de yuè lái yuè màn le
en: Xiao Li is running slower and slower.
why: With an action verb 越来越 goes after 得: 跑得越来越慢. 越来越 cannot be put before 跑步.

src: 你的桌子大，我的桌子小。
src_py: nǐ de zhuō zi dà wǒ de zhuō zi xiǎo
task: Combine into one sentence with 比, starting with 你的桌子.
zh: 你的桌子比我的大。
py: nǐ de zhuō zi bǐ wǒ de dà
en: Your desk is bigger than mine.
why: The two clauses merge into A 比 B + adjective, with the bare adjective at the end.

src: 小李的感冒很重，我的感冒更重。
src_py: xiǎo lǐ de gǎn mào hěn zhòng wǒ de gǎn mào gèng zhòng
task: Combine into one sentence with 比 and 更, starting with 我的感冒.
zh: 我的感冒比小李的更重。
py: wǒ de gǎn mào bǐ xiǎo lǐ de gèng zhòng
en: My cold is even worse than Xiao Li's.
why: 更 is the degree word allowed in a 比 sentence. 很 would not be possible there.

src: 我今年三十岁，小王今年二十八岁。
src_py: wǒ jīn nián sān shí suì xiǎo wáng jīn nián èr shí bā suì
task: Say how much older I am than Xiao Wang, using 比.
zh: 我比小王大两岁。
py: wǒ bǐ xiǎo wáng dà liǎng suì
en: I'm two years older than Xiao Wang.
why: The two-year gap goes after 大 in a 比 sentence.

src: 这种药十块，那种药八块。
src_py: zhè zhǒng yào shí kuài nà zhǒng yào bā kuài
task: Say this one is two yuan more expensive, using 比.
zh: 这种药比那种贵两块。
py: zhè zhǒng yào bǐ nà zhǒng guì liǎng kuài
en: This medicine is two yuan more expensive than that kind.
why: The exact difference 两块 follows the adjective 贵.

src: 昨天的会开了一个小时，今天的会开了三个小时。
src_py: zuó tiān de huì kāi le yí ge xiǎo shí jīn tiān de huì kāi le sān ge xiǎo shí
task: Say today's meeting is two hours longer, using 比 (start with 今天的会).
zh: 今天的会比昨天的长两个小时。
py: jīn tiān de huì bǐ zuó tiān de cháng liǎng ge xiǎo shí
en: Today's meeting is two hours longer than yesterday's.
why: Amount of difference after the adjective: 长两个小时. It cannot come before 长.

src: 他很忙，我不太忙。
src_py: tā hěn máng wǒ bù tài máng
task: Say I'm not as busy as he is, using 没有.
zh: 我没有他忙。
py: wǒ méi yǒu tā máng
en: I'm not as busy as he is.
why: 没有 B + adjective says 'not as ... as'. 比 plus a negated adjective would be wrong.

src: 我比小王累。
src_py: wǒ bǐ xiǎo wáng lèi
task: Reverse it: say Xiao Wang is not as tired as I am, using 没有.
zh: 小王没有我累。
py: xiǎo wáng méi yǒu wǒ lèi
en: Xiao Wang isn't as tired as I am.
why: Swap the two people and use 没有: A 没有 B + adjective.

src: 昨天比今天冷。
src_py: zuó tiān bǐ jīn tiān lěng
task: Say today is not as cold as yesterday, using 没有 and 那么.
zh: 今天没有昨天那么冷。
py: jīn tiān méi yǒu zuó tiān nà me lěng
en: Today isn't as cold as yesterday.
why: 没有 B 那么 + adjective is the negative of 比. 那么 stands right before the adjective.

src: 他比我高。
src_py: tā bǐ wǒ gāo
task: Disagree: say he is no taller than me, using 不比.
zh: 他不比我高。
py: tā bù bǐ wǒ gāo
en: He's no taller than me.
why: 不比 is the negative of 比. It says he is not taller, and the two may be the same.

src: 那个办法比这个办法好。
src_py: nà ge bàn fǎ bǐ zhè ge bàn fǎ hǎo
task: Say this one is not as good as that one, using 不如.
zh: 这个办法不如那个办法好。
py: zhè ge bàn fǎ bù rú nà ge bàn fǎ hǎo
en: This method is not as good as that one.
why: 不如 B + a positive adjective says A falls short of B. 不如 is not combined with 比.

src: 我二十五岁，小李也二十五岁。
src_py: wǒ èr shí wǔ suì xiǎo lǐ yě èr shí wǔ suì
task: Say we are the same age, using 跟 and 一样 (use 大).
zh: 我跟小李一样大。
py: wǒ gēn xiǎo lǐ yī yàng dà
en: I'm the same age as Xiao Li.
why: 跟 B 一样 + adjective expresses equality. 大 here means age.

src: 你的工作很忙，我的工作也很忙。
src_py: nǐ de gōng zuò hěn máng wǒ de gōng zuò yě hěn máng
task: Say yours is just as busy as mine, using 和 and 一样, starting with 你的工作.
zh: 你的工作和我的一样忙。
py: nǐ de gōng zuò hé wǒ de yī yàng máng
en: Your job is just as busy as mine.
why: 和 B 一样 + adjective. 很 is dropped because 一样 already says 'equally'.

src: 我们部门的人都没有小王高。
src_py: wǒ men bù mén de rén dōu méi yǒu xiǎo wáng gāo
task: Say Xiao Wang is the tallest in our department, using 最.
zh: 小王是我们部门最高的。
py: xiǎo wáng shì wǒ men bù mén zuì gāo de
en: Xiao Wang is the tallest in our department.
why: The group 我们部门 goes before 最, and 最 stands right before the adjective.

src: 这个问题有一点儿难。
src_py: zhè ge wèn tí yǒu yī diǎn r nán
task: Say it with 比较 instead of 有一点儿.
zh: 这个问题比较难。
py: zhè ge wèn tí bǐ jiào nán
en: This question is fairly difficult.
why: 比较 sits directly before the adjective and names no B.

src: 我跑得快，他跑得更快。
src_py: wǒ pǎo de kuài tā pǎo de gèng kuài
task: Combine into one sentence with 比, starting with 他.
zh: 他比我跑得快。
py: tā bǐ wǒ pǎo de kuài
en: He runs faster than me.
why: Both 他比我跑得快 and 他跑得比我快 are correct; 得 must stay after the verb.

src: 李医生写字写得很好，小王写字写得不太好。
src_py: lǐ yī shēng xiě zì xiě de hěn hǎo xiǎo wáng xiě zì xiě de bù tài hǎo
task: Say Dr Li writes better than Xiao Wang, using 比 and starting with 李医生.
zh: 李医生写字写得比小王好。
py: lǐ yī shēng xiě zì xiě de bǐ xiǎo wáng hǎo
en: Dr Li writes better than Xiao Wang.
why: The verb is repeated for the object 写字. 比小王 can sit before the first 写字 or the second 写得, or follow 得.

src: 我每天七点起床，小王每天八点起床。
src_py: wǒ měi tiān qī diǎn qǐ chuáng xiǎo wáng měi tiān bā diǎn qǐ chuáng
task: Say I get up earlier than Xiao Wang, using 比 and 得.
zh: 我起得比小王早。
py: wǒ qǐ de bǐ xiǎo wáng zǎo
en: I get up earlier than Xiao Wang.
why: 起得 keeps 得 between the verb and the adjective. 比小王 sits before 起得 or right after it.

src: 我的工作一天比一天忙。
src_py: wǒ de gōng zuò yī tiān bǐ yī tiān máng
task: Say it with 越来越.
zh: 我的工作越来越忙了。
py: wǒ de gōng zuò yuè lái yuè máng le
en: My work is getting busier and busier.
why: 越来越 stands right before the adjective, with 了 at the end. 一天比一天 is replaced.

src: 他的身体一天比一天好。
src_py: tā de shēn tǐ yī tiān bǐ yī tiān hǎo
task: Say it with 越来越.
zh: 他的身体越来越好了。
py: tā de shēn tǐ yuè lái yuè hǎo le
en: His health is getting better and better.
why: 越来越 replaces 一天比一天. No 很 or 更 can be added.

src: 他吃得一天比一天少。
src_py: tā chī de yī tiān bǐ yī tiān shǎo
task: Say it with 越来越 and 得.
zh: 他吃得越来越少了。
py: tā chī de yuè lái yuè shǎo le
en: He's eating less and less.
why: After 得, 越来越 comes right before the adjective: 吃得越来越少了.

s: 我的办公室比你的很大。
s_py: wǒ de bàn gōng shì bǐ nǐ de hěn dà
zh: 我的办公室比你的大。
py: wǒ de bàn gōng shì bǐ nǐ de dà
en: My office is bigger than yours.
why: 很 cannot be put before an adjective in a 比 sentence. The adjective stays bare.

s: 这个星期比上个星期还忙。
s_py: zhè ge xīng qī bǐ shàng ge xīng qī hái máng
zh: 这个星期比上个星期还忙。
py: zhè ge xīng qī bǐ shàng ge xīng qī hái máng
en: This week is even busier than last week.
why: 还 is allowed before the adjective in a 比 sentence and means 'even'. The sentence is correct.

s: 这个月的会比上个月比较多。
s_py: zhè ge yuè de huì bǐ shàng ge yuè bǐ jiào duō
zh: 这个月的会比上个月多。
py: zhè ge yuè de huì bǐ shàng ge yuè duō
en: This month there are more meetings than last month.
why: 比较 means 'fairly' and cannot be added to a 比 sentence, which already says 'than'.

s: 新同事比我三岁小。
s_py: xīn tóng shì bǐ wǒ sān suì xiǎo
zh: 新同事比我小三岁。
py: xīn tóng shì bǐ wǒ xiǎo sān suì
en: The new colleague is three years younger than me.
why: The amount of the difference goes after the adjective: 小三岁, not before it as in English.

s: 吃了药，他今天比昨天好多了。
s_py: chī le yào tā jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān hǎo duō le
zh: 吃了药，他今天比昨天好多了。
py: chī le yào tā jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān hǎo duō le
en: After taking the medicine, he is much better today than yesterday.
why: 好多了 is the correct way to say 'much better' in a 比 sentence: the amount comes after the adjective.

s: 这家医院比那家医院很远得多。
s_py: zhè jiā yī yuàn bǐ nà jiā yī yuàn hěn yuǎn de duō
zh: 这家医院比那家医院远得多。
py: zhè jiā yī yuàn bǐ nà jiā yī yuàn yuǎn de duō
en: This hospital is much farther away than that one.
why: 得多 already gives 'much'. 很 cannot stand before the adjective in a 比 sentence.

s: 新同事比我不忙。
s_py: xīn tóng shì bǐ wǒ bù máng
zh: 新同事没有我忙。
py: xīn tóng shì méi yǒu wǒ máng
en: The new colleague isn't as busy as I am.
why: 'Not as busy as' is 没有 B + adjective. 比 is not negated at the adjective.

s: 这个星期的会没有上个星期那么多。
s_py: zhè ge xīng qī de huì méi yǒu shàng ge xīng qī nà me duō
zh: 这个星期的会没有上个星期那么多。
py: zhè ge xīng qī de huì méi yǒu shàng ge xīng qī nà me duō
en: This week there are not as many meetings as last week.
why: 没有 B 那么 + adjective is correct for 'not as ... as'.

s: 这家诊所不如那家差，大家都愿意去那家。
s_py: zhè jiā zhěn suǒ bù rú nà jiā chà dà jiā dōu yuàn yì qù nà jiā
zh: 这家诊所不如那家好，大家都愿意去那家。
py: zhè jiā zhěn suǒ bù rú nà jiā hǎo dà jiā dōu yuàn yì qù nà jiā
en: This clinic is not as good as that one, so everyone prefers to go to that one.
why: 不如 B is followed by a positive adjective like 好. 差 would reverse the meaning.

s: 这个方案不比那个方案好，只是便宜一点儿。
s_py: zhè ge fāng àn bù bǐ nà ge fāng àn hǎo zhǐ shì pián yi yī diǎn r
zh: 这个方案不比那个方案好，只是便宜一点儿。
py: zhè ge fāng àn bù bǐ nà ge fāng àn hǎo zhǐ shì pián yi yī diǎn r
en: This plan is no better than that one, it is just a little cheaper.
why: 不比 means 'no more than' and allows the two to be equal, which fits 'only a little cheaper'.

s: 我的汉语比不如他。
s_py: wǒ de hàn yǔ bǐ bù rú tā
zh: 我的汉语不如他。
py: wǒ de hàn yǔ bù rú tā
en: My Chinese is not as good as his.
why: 不如 replaces 比. The two cannot be combined.

s: 我的工作比你的一样忙。
s_py: wǒ de gōng zuò bǐ nǐ de yī yàng máng
zh: 我的工作跟你的一样忙。
py: wǒ de gōng zuò gēn nǐ de yī yàng máng
en: My job is just as busy as yours.
why: 比 marks a difference and cannot go with 一样. Sameness uses 跟 or 和.

s: 这两种药的颜色不一样，可是作用一样。
s_py: zhè liǎng zhǒng yào de yán sè bù yí yàng kě shì zuò yòng yī yàng
zh: 这两种药的颜色不一样，可是作用一样。
py: zhè liǎng zhǒng yào de yán sè bù yí yàng kě shì zuò yòng yī yàng
en: The colours of these two medicines are different, but they work the same way.
why: 不一样 and 一样 can stand alone without an adjective. The sentence is correct.

s: 他的血压跟我一样很高，都得吃药。
s_py: tā de xuè yā gēn wǒ yī yàng hěn gāo dōu děi chī yào
zh: 他的血压跟我一样高，都得吃药。
py: tā de xuè yā gēn wǒ yī yàng gāo dōu děi chī yào
en: His blood pressure is as high as mine; we both need medicine.
why: After 一样 the adjective is bare. 很 cannot be added.

s: 这个药比较那个药贵。
s_py: zhè ge yào bǐ jiào nà ge yào guì
zh: 这个药比那个药贵。
py: zhè ge yào bǐ nà ge yào guì
en: This medicine is more expensive than that one.
why: 比较 before an adjective means 'fairly'. 'Than' is 比 alone.

s: 这个星期最忙的人不是我，是小李。
s_py: zhè ge xīng qī zuì máng de rén bú shì wǒ shì xiǎo lǐ
zh: 这个星期最忙的人不是我，是小李。
py: zhè ge xīng qī zuì máng de rén bú shì wǒ shì xiǎo lǐ
en: The busiest person this week is not me, it's Xiao Li.
why: 最 goes before the adjective and 的 turns it into a noun phrase. The sentence is correct.

s: 小王做报告得比我好。
s_py: xiǎo wáng zuò bào gào de bǐ wǒ hǎo
zh: 小王做报告做得比我好。
py: xiǎo wáng zuò bào gào zuò de bǐ wǒ hǎo
en: Xiao Wang gives presentations better than I do.
why: The verb must be repeated, so that 得 follows the verb directly. 汉语 cannot sit between 说 and 得.

s: 弟弟吃得比我多，可是还没我胖。
s_py: dì di chī de bǐ wǒ duō kě shì hái méi wǒ pàng
zh: 弟弟吃得比我多，可是还没我胖。
py: dì di chī de bǐ wǒ duō kě shì hái méi wǒ pàng
en: My younger brother eats more than I do, but he's still not as fat as me.
why: 吃得比我多 is the correct comparison of an action. 没我胖 is also a valid 没有 comparison.

s: 最近天气越来越很热。
s_py: zuì jìn tiān qì yuè lái yuè hěn rè
zh: 最近天气越来越热。
py: zuì jìn tiān qì yuè lái yuè rè
en: The weather has been getting hotter and hotter lately.
why: 越来越 already gives the degree. 很 cannot follow it.

s: 他越来越喜欢这家公司了。
s_py: tā yuè lái yuè xǐ huan zhè jiā gōng sī le
zh: 他越来越喜欢这家公司了。
py: tā yuè lái yuè xǐ huan zhè jiā gōng sī le
en: He likes this company more and more.
why: 越来越 can stand before a verb of feeling like 喜欢. The sentence is correct.
